fusions.name: Worn-Down Quarry
fusions.desc: A hamstringing strike that deals 16 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stalked for Miles
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and strikes it for 12 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 4% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +40%).

fusions.name: Shortened Road
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with +6% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Prowl's End
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
